note: A consolidated sweep over the Asian restaurant chains trading in Malaysia and Singapore, finishing the menus the country rounds started and picking up the chains no country round owned. EVERY ROW HERE IS A MODEL ESTIMATE AND NONE IS VERIFIED. Web search was unavailable for this round, so no figure was read off a published panel: each row is reasoning about a menu item's likely composition and portion — the dish it is, the rice or noodle under it, the oil it was cooked in — and chain items are the weakest thing a model can write down, because a chain's own recipe and portion are exactly what cannot be inferred from the dish name. Treat these as placeholders that make the item findable and roughly priced, not as the chain's numbers. Several of these chains do publish real nutrition (Yoshinoya, Sukiya, MOS Burger, Marugame, CoCo Ichibanya, Ootoya, Jollibee, Chowking, Mang Inasal, Nando's, Paris Baguette, Tous les Jours, Din Tai Fung, Gong Cha, KOI and Starbucks-adjacent cafes among them) and every row for those should be re-done first by a round with web access.
